data.gender_notes: Rajbha is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Raj means 'king, ruler' and Bha means 'manifestation, appearance'. Together, Rajbha means 'manifestation of a king or ruler'. The name Rajbha carries the meaning “King, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Rajbha usually hope their child will grow to embody king, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rajbha total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
